title: Efforts to Combat Spread of COVID-19 on Public Buses and Trains
what_it_is: Efforts to Combat Spread of COVID-19 on Public Buses and Trains

sections.label: Infection prevention framework and transport measures
sections.summary: The framework gives general guidelines but not sector-specific measures, and the Government develops measures; public transport workers returning from mainland China were not deployed to frontline duties since 28 January 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The framework provides general guidelines on what needs to be done to prevent and reduce the impact of infections, but does not prescribe specific measures for various sectors at the different alert levels.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Government will develop relevant measures, taking into account the unique characteristics of the disease based on the latest available information and the requirements of each sector.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: For example, since 28 January 2020, all public transport workers returning from mainland China have not been deployed to frontline duties.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This measure was put in place ahead of the mandatory 14-day leave of absence to be served by all workers returning from mainland China from 31 January 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Operators have also implemented more frequent cleaning of public surface areas and high commuter touchpoints, placed hand sanitisers at Mass Rapid Transit stations and bus interchanges for use by staff and commuters, and conducted twice-daily temperature screening for all staff.

sections.label: Public transport social distancing and community transmission
sections.summary: Trains will be less crowded and travel safer with some social distancing, but there is very limited community transmission and no plans for such measures now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: At least, the trains will not be so crowded, travelling will be a lot safer with at least some social distancing implemented.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: But in a broader context, the information we have so far is that there is very limited community transmission link in clusters.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Currently, as I understand the postures of the other Ministries, there are no plans for those types of measures to be instituted at this point in time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Our public transport systems are serving the public well and there is no reason to believe that we should not continue to use them to get to work, to get to school and to go about our usual daily business.
